## Change

F1. Prefer core-offered finish choice for select/unselect prompts instead of endlessly toggling the first card after a valid selection. Preserve first-choice fallback when finish absent.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral red/green captured. Parent inspected can_finish producer and policy path, reran 21 policy tests. Worker related/replay/real-engine Chapter 1 suite: 27 passed; boundaries 52. Typecheck, targeted lint/format and diff checks pass.

## Limits

L1. Native-engine runs do not prove this exact prompt shape occurred; focused production-policy regression does. Full repository/browser gates not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(opponent): finish valid toggle selections
